bulletin.text:
Morning of 23 November 2026. Fires detected on 22 November 2026 put 1 fires in Priority 1 in West Kalimantan. The ten fires at the top of the list carry 53% of the modelled smoke over residents.

Fire 1, near Ketapang, carries 53.3% of it; 1,247,077 residents live within 40 km of its smoke path, and its smoke is heading NE, already over Ketapang as the window opens.

This is a ranking index, not a forecast of smoke concentration. People outside Indonesia are not counted. The task force decides.
